content.value_statement: Teams need consistent Anthropic-style visuals across documents and slides. This skill provides palette, typography, and layout guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Provides Anthropic-style main and accent color values for visual artifacts.
Defines heading and body typography choices with common fallback fonts.
Guides smart text color selection based on background contrast.
Recommends accent color cycling for non-text shapes and visual elements.
Documents use of RGB color values for presentation color matching.
limitations: It does not include official logo files, image assets, or downloadable brand templates.
It does not install Poppins, Lora, or other fonts on the user's system.
It is a community skill, so users should verify official rules for public brand use.
It provides guidance only and does not include executable automation scripts.

output_examples.input: A draft slide deck uses default fonts, mixed colors, and inconsistent shape styling.
output: Headings use the recommended display font with a standard fallback.
Body text uses the recommended serif font with a readable fallback.
Accent shapes rotate through orange, blue, and green for balanced emphasis.

output_examples.input: A technical report needs a consistent Anthropic-style visual identity.
output_examples.output: The report receives a restrained dark and light palette, clearer heading hierarchy, and consistent accent colors for callouts.

output_examples.input: A diagram has low contrast labels and unrelated colors.
output_examples.output: Labels are adjusted for readable contrast, and non-text elements use the documented accent colors.

best_practices: Use the palette consistently across related artifacts before adding extra colors.
Check text contrast after applying dark, light, and accent colors.
Install the recommended fonts when exact typography matters.
anti_patterns: Do not treat this community skill as official legal approval for brand use.
Do not add unrelated colors when the documented accents are sufficient.
Do not sacrifice readability to match a color choice exactly.

faq.question: Is this an official Anthropic brand package?
faq.answer: No. It is a community skill that summarizes styling guidance and should be verified for public brand use.

faq.question: Can it install fonts for me?
faq.answer: No. It recommends Poppins and Lora with fallbacks, but it does not install fonts.

faq.question: Does it include logos or image assets?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on colors, typography, accents, and visual styling guidance.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it style PowerPoint presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes presentation-oriented guidance and references RGB color application.

faq.question: Should I use it for commercial materials?
faq.answer: Use it as a drafting aid, then verify current official Anthropic brand requirements before publication.
